title: btavrcp/obex: Add support for AVRCP cover art
description:
AVRCP utilizes the BIP profile, which runs on OBEX, for transferring cover art
images. The AVRCP dissector currently doesn't know how to process packets on
the BIP connection. It also doesn't support the cover art attribute.

The L2CAP PSM for the cover art service is stored in the AVRCP target SDP record
of a device. When the AVRCP dissector receives L2CAP packets that are not
associated with an AVCTP connection, it will check the stored SDP records to see
if the L2CAP connection is using the cover art PSM. If the PSM is for cover art,
hand off dissection to the OBEX dissector.

notes.body: Don't do this, call `proto_get_id_by_filter_name` in the OBEX handoff function.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/26164/diffs?diff_id=1963211891&start_sha=202e53234eda7adb439212c173dfdcafb958c22b#4358125927eb2147475e25d66a19e1cbe843ed8d_26_25)
